title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
author: Arthur C. Clarke
summary: A mysterious black slab guides early humans toward intelligence, and millions of years later another one is found on the Moon. A spaceship travels toward Saturn with an advanced computer in charge, and something goes wrong.
readIf: you want a clear, cosmic version of one of science fiction's most famous stories.
skipIf: you want a lot of character, since the book values scale and wonder over personality.

pairings.reason: The author's other grand vision of humanity's next step, quieter and more elegiac.
A more unsettling story of an encounter with an intelligence that cannot be understood.
